name: Ichinose Miu
source:
She is a beautiful girl, no matter how you look at her. Her hair is long and straight, down to her shoulder blades. It was so shiny that I wanted to ask her, “Have you just had a bath? I would like to ask her if she has just finished taking a bath. Her bangs are slicked back in a ladylike style. Her face is like a lady's with big eyes and a straight nose.

Her face is so well-defined that it would be troublesome to explain every detail. Her overall impression is innocent. The most impressive features are her cheeks, which are smooth and moist like peaches, and her lips, which are full and plump. Her brother gets angry when he thinks that someday, some bastard will take those lips away from him. I'm sure their father feels the same way.

[From [url=http://lyricbox.jp/IMOZI/]official site[/url]]
